per_session_average.trend: INCREASING from ~3 to ~12 files/session over project lifetime

keep_types: Session summaries (*_SESSION_SUMMARY.md) — primary cross-session handoff mechanism
Portfolio-level dashboards (*_DASHBOARD.json from milestone sessions only)
Risk registers (*_RISK_REGISTER.json) — consumed by downstream planning
Completion forecasts (*_COMPLETION_FORECAST.json) — used by next-wave planning
Certification results (*_CERTIFICATION_RESULTS.json) — consumed by portfolio dashboards
Defect sweep reports (defect_sweeps/*.md) — cross-referenced from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md
Governance attestations (*_GOVERNANCE_ATTESTATION.md) — required for compliance trail
Session status files (session_status/SESSION_STATUS_*.md) — authoritative state snapshots
retire_types: Individual agent outputs (agent_*.json, SESSION301_AGENT_*.json) — 120+ files, consumed only within their session
Duplicate dashboard variants (6-7 per session S310+) — merge to single DASHBOARD.json per session
Meta-reporting packages (*_REPORTING_PACKAGE.json) — reports about reports, zero downstream value
100-series incremental status logs (SESSION100-SESSION135) — 170 files, zero downstream reference
Pilot dry-run exports (SESSION116_EXPORTS/*.json, SESSION118_EXPORTS/*.json) — 17 synthetic student files
Per-session non-milestone dashboards — S314 dashboard consumed only by S315, then forgotten
One-off snapshot audits (Closure Baseline, Dependency Map, Strategy Board) — consumed within session only
Legacy naming variants (S809.2_AGENT_*, s116_pilot_*) — inconsistent naming, zero traceability
Forecast duplicates (FORECAST + COMPLETION_FORECAST per session) — merge to single file

recommended_immediate_actions: MERGE: Dashboard variants (6-7 per session S310+) into single DASHBOARD.json per session
ELIMINATE: REPORTING_PACKAGE meta-reports (3 files) — reports about reports
EMBED: Agent outputs into session summaries rather than persisting as standalone JSON
ARCHIVE: 100-series status logs (170 files, 62 sessions) — zero downstream consumption
MERGE: PORTFOLIO_IMPACT + CERTIFICATION_RESULTS + QUALITY_GATE into single Results Package

CAP: Add 'max 8 files per session' soft cap to governance — sessions exceeding 8 need BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker
methodology_note: File counts exclude 2 .bak backup copies of GOVERNANCE_AND_RISK_REGISTER_CONSOLIDATED.md. Consumption analysis cross-references REVISION_HISTORY.md (1,235,584 chars), DEFECT_LIBRARY.md, and AGENTS.md.
